visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) Daisy stands in an art studio, wearing a denim apron over a black spaghetti-strap top and a small cross necklace. She holds a blue-and-pink rabbit sculpture with a yellow heart on its chest. The background features the text 'PEARL STUDIO' on a gray wall and various posters. She smiles and gestures with her free hand while speaking directly to the camera in a bright indoor setting. (2) A puzzle-style transition effect shows Daisy holding a pink version of the rabbit sculpture. Then, the scene shifts to her actively painting; she uses sponges to apply dabs of blue and pink paint onto a white base sculpture on a cluttered work table. Her hair is down, and she looks focused yet cheerful as she demonstrates the artistic process in the workshop environment. (3) The camera provides a detailed close-up of the finished rabbit figurine, highlighting the text 'GROW HOPE' on its base and the star-patterned eyes. It then pans quickly across a long black table in a gallery setting, revealing dozens of other rabbit sculptures, each uniquely decorated with different colors, patterns, and accessories by various artists under high-contrast studio lighting. (4) Five individuals (three women and two men) are positioned in a group shot within the studio. Each person holds a different rabbit sculpture. They are smiling and posing, with Daisy in the front left making a finger-heart gesture. The background includes a promotional poster for a charity event, and the lighting is warm and inviting, concluding the visual sequence with a sense of community.
